item.tib: stag la bkra shis gter rdzong las/ phyag bzhes rin chen 'phreng ba'i rgyan
item.coloph: ces stag lha thugs kyi sgrub pa bkra shis gter rdzong zhes bya ba las/ sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba'i 'phrin las go rim cung zad dbye ru phyes pa 'di/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan skyes bu rnams kyi don du/ tshad med bzhi ldan sems bskyed gtsor byas nas/ sa sprel zla 3 tshes 1u0f8bkong yul ljon pa'i tshal/ ngo mtshar gnas chen bon ri'i mdun zhol du/ snyigs ma'i kho bo byang chub rdo rje rtsal/ nye bar sbyar ba'i dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ ma rung bdud srin log pa 'dul ba dang / rjes 'jug skal ldan bsnyen bsgrub mthar phyin nas/ khro rgyal stag lha'i sku ru 'grub 'gyur cig/
